metaDescription: Project enquiries, a correction on a post, or a question about something we published. One inbox, read by a person, answered within two working days.
title: Write to us, we read all of it
lede: A project, a correction, a question about a build: it lands in the same inbox and a person answers it. No ticket number, no autoresponder.
directLede: Plain email works just as well, and a thread is easier to keep than a form.

If it is a correction, the post is fixed and credited the same week.
